text_block_list.text:
Today is a rest day from training.
Days like this are perfect for immersing myself in paperwork.
Just as I was enthusiastically about to leave the room—

The sender was—Symboli Kris S.
Please come to the cafe this afternoon—written in an earnest, straightforward hand, it was an "invitation."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Happy Valentine's Day.
âHere.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Today is... Valentine's Day.
Please... allow me to escort you today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Flowers—have a—healing effect.
—First—please accept this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
This shop... has a reputation... for sweets, apparently.
...I also hear... the coffee... is good.
choice_data_list: Well then, I'll have the cake and coffee...

text_block_list.text: A bit bewildered by the surprise escort, I simply order what is recommended.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Is it... delicious?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I see.

After taking my time savoring the exquisite sweets,
where I was brought next was—
choice_data_list: A planetarium, huh? It's been a while.
A planetarium, huh? Feels like it's been a while.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
This is—a popular facility—
specializing in—healing, apparently.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —A blanket... is it needed?
choice_data_list: Thank you, I think I will take it.

text_block_list.name: Building Announcement
text_block_list.text:
The projection will begin shortly.
It will get dark during the screening, so please watch your step—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—It begins.
Your seat is—over here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This starry sky represents Valentine's Day night.
Speaking of winter constellations, Orion comes first.
Between the four corner stars, the three belt stars line up beautifully—

A beautiful, fantastical starry sky spread out before my eyes.
A gentle aroma drifted in from somewhere, bringing a deep sense of peace...

text_block_list.name: Building Announcement
text_block_list.text: —And that concludes it.

text_block_list.name: Building Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Please make sure you haven't left anything behind,
and have a safe trip home.
Enveloped by the beautiful starry sky, the gentle darkness, and the warmth of the blanket—soaking in the deep relaxation, I dozed off completely.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
...Did you... enjoy it?
choice_data_list: A-Ah! I dozed off a little, but...
Y-Yeah! I ended up sleeping a bit, though...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I see. —That's good.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It's about time—let's go.
I'll guide you—to the next one.

—We were led into a restaurant.
Apparently, they had gone out of their way to make a reservation for us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I see. ...That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Is there—any other dish—you're interested in?
—The roast lamb—is also said to be—popular.
choice_data_list: Well then, maybe I'll have that one.

text_block_list.text:
Savoring the delicious food at a leisurely pace,
I feel completely relaxed.

I feel like I'm forgetting
something important, but—

I had planned to do paperwork today!
I was so thoroughly soothed by everything Symboli Kris S showed me that it slipped my mind entirely...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Did I... end up remembering...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "No—you are—diligent. If you've remembered it—it can't be helped."

Judging by the way she's talking...
Could it be that she brought me out here just to help me forget about work?
choice_data_list: Is that why you've been escorting me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Ah—it's Valentine's Day, after all...
I thought I'd rest... at least for today.
choice_data_list: So in America, is it a day of rest?
So in America, is it a day of rest?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "No—it's a day—to express your everyday—gratitude—to family and friends."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: So—I thought I would grant you—a little rest.
choice_data_list: I see... Thank you, that makes me so happy.

text_block_list.text: Thanks to Symboli Kris S, I felt deeply soothed and refreshed. Her thoughtfulness warms my heart.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Ah―― thank goodness.

I'll do my best to live up to the feelings I've received.
With renewed determination—upon returning to the academy, I tackled the paperwork with fiery passion.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It's fine to forget. —At least, for today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――You're always working yourself to the bone...
――all for... my sake...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—I am... grateful. To you... for resonating with...
and supporting... my mission.”

Her mission is my mission.
Since I chose to shoulder it with her and make it a reality,
working toward that goal is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —However... to fulfill my mission... I also require rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise—efficiency will drop.
So—get some proper rest today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
And—starting tomorrow—
I'll be counting on you again.

Symboli Kris S's eyes softened as she spoke.
Her gaze brimmed with a tender, caring warmth.
choice_data_list: Is that why you escorted me today?
Is that why you escorted me today?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Ah—it is Valentine's Day, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—In America—my family, my friends—
those who took care of me—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—Giving a gift... to someone special.
It's a day to convey—gratitude and feelings.”
Symboli Kris S's kind thoughts touch my heart more than anything—bringing profound comfort.

I'll take advantage of her kindness and get some rest for today. And then—
starting tomorrow, I'll give it my all for her sake again.
